title: Independently replay #4534's noncommuting p16 identity in the free algebra: all 1,024 entries, chronology-sensitive (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

This adds `research/free-controller-replay/`. It is an independent free-algebra replay of the noncommuting-stage theorem in Dugongue's #4534: #4470's p16 controller stays exactly diagonalizable with pairwise noncommuting `D_s` that commute with the central `Q`. It extends my commutative replay #4516 to ordered words.

**Claim type:** an independent exact replay. **No new κ.**

## Results

- **The identity.** `L·W·R = diag(q^{ε_i} d_{w_i})` holds in **all 1,024 entries**, coefficient by coefficient over ordered words in `ℚ⟨d_s⟩[q, q^{−1}]`, using #4534's certificate (vendored, SHA256-pinned).
- **Chronology.** Reversing the idle words breaks 212 entries, so the check is sensitive to chronology.
- **Structure.** Exponents are 16 of each sign. `G = (32, 31, 29, …, 1, 0)`, and the other 15 words are contiguous prefixes or suffixes of `G`.
- **Boundaries.** `L` and `R` are invertible, and they and their inverses are dyadic.

## Evidence

```text
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/free-controller-replay --check-only
  PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS (not a mathematical acceptance check)
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/free-controller-replay
  PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/free-controller-replay outcome=completed   (~1 s, stdlib only)
```

Head: `84c19218bca3b2c963e98a545481f32d78e77b17`. Base: canonical main `f9f85c1e`.

## Not covered

- #4534's adapter, retiming and lazy-response tools.
- Any physical noncommuting `D_s`.
